picks.showTitle: Chinmaya Mission - Gita, Upanishads and Ancient Knowledge
picks.title: Can You Train Your Mind? | Essence of the Geeta | Episode 87
picks.summary: Swami Swaroopananda, Global Head of Chinmaya Mission, is a revered spiritual leader known for his clear, profound Vedanta teachings. His wisdom guides many towards self-discovery and inner peace, making complex concepts accessible and inspiring globally. In this series, Swamiji distills the learnings from the Bhagavad Geeta and explains it in a way that allows everyone to enjoy the essence of the Geeta.
picks.reason: Explores training the mind with clear Vedanta teachings from the Bhagavad Gita.

picks.title: Vivarta siddhānta: Uḷḷadu Nāṟpadu verse 1 & Guru Vācaka Kōvai verse 83
picks.summary:
In an online meeting with the Ramana Maharshi Foundation UK on 12th September 2026, Michael explains Vivarta siddhānta: Uḷḷadu Nāṟpadu verse 1 (https://sriramanateachings.org/blog/2017/10/ulladu-narpadu-tamil-text.html#un01and ) Guru Vācaka Kōvai verse 83 (https://sriramanateachings.org/gvk-translations.html#gvk83 ), and then answers questions on Bhagavan Ramana's teachings. 
This episode is available as a video on YouTube. A more compressed audio copy in Opus format can be downloaded from MediaFire. Michael's explanations on the original works of Bhagavan can be watched free of advertisements
picks.reason: Explains Vivarta siddhanta and Ramana Maharshi's teachings deeply.

picks.title: 🛣️  Choose Independence Over Dependence
picks.summary:
Shri Krishna reveals how every moment offers a choice between dependence and independence, between valuables and values. By aligning our vision and lifestyle with Enlightenment and steadily choosing the path of independence, we move toward living as pure Awareness.
➡️ This season, we are exploring the 70 essential verses of the Shrimad Bhagavad Gita. To maximize your experience of this season, we encourage you to request your FREE copy of the Essential Love eBook. Incorporating accessible translations and practical application, the eBook accompanies each episode with additional ways to learn,
picks.reason: Focuses on choosing independence and values through Bhagavad Gita's spiritual guidance.

picks.title: 1824: You're Not in Control | The Placebo Illusion and the Bhakti Reality
picks.summary: Our sense of security is based on illusion — confirmed by both modern science and the sages of the Bhakti Yoga tradition. A landmark psychiatric study reveals something startling about what actually determines whether we panic or stay calm. The Vedic sages were ahead of the curve, and put it plainly: we are living in two illusions — false terror and false security. The material energy is infinitely more powerful than us. picks.reason: Connects Bhakti Yoga's view on illusion and security with modern science and spiritual awakening.

picks.reason: Explores Bhagavatam's unique view of God as a playful, embodied divine figure.

picks.title: 1823: Life Is Sacred and Life Is Everywhere | The Earth Personified in Krishna's Pastimes
picks.summary: In the form of a beautiful teenager God enters a new city, meets a hunchback girl in the street, transforms her body and enters a romance with her. On the surface it sounds bizarre. But read with the right eyes, it is rich in ecological and theological depth. The girl is an expansion of Mother Earth herself, bent low under the burden of wicked rulers. Krishna straightens her out, indicates the value in loving nature personified, and demonstrates how God can reciprocate with all varieties of love. Srimad Bhagavatam 10.42. 1-18  *******************************************************************
picks.reason: Examines Krishna's pastimes as ecological and theological metaphors in Hindu thought.
